configuration.comment: select the statecodename from Opportunity table, count the number of rows with each distinct statecodename value, grouped by statecodename column
configuration.query: Show me the breakdown of Opportunities by status
configuration.rephrase: The query will show the count of opportunities grouped by statecodename.
configuration.standardsql: SELECT [statecodename], COUNT(*) AS [opportunityCount] FROM [Opportunity] GROUP BY [statecodename]
